$comment: Plans, credit and usage (src/domain/billing.ts, functions/billing). Additive: five new schemas and EngineJob.UsageJson. Apply expand-first on every tenant BEFORE deploying the web app, the functions or the engine worker; then run billing.plans.seed once (idempotent, RequestKey plan:<key>) or let billing.plans.list answer the default plans until it runs. PlatformSetting keys billing.priceFactor (default 1) and billing.signupCreditUsd (default 50) are read with these defaults when absent. Validations: validations.json; indexes: indexes.json; policies: policies.json (service writes only, super-admin reads).

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: Key
fields.description: Plan key (lower-case, e.g. free|classic|speed|enterprise); unique.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Plan name shown to people.

fields.name: PriceUsd
fields.description: Price per month in USD; 0 for Free; absent/0 with ContactSales for a price agreed with sales.

fields.name: CreditUsd
fields.description: Credit in USD granted when the plan starts (each month for paid plans; the sign-up credit for Free).

fields.name: Assisted
fields.description: Human help: none|tech-lead|business|dedicated.

fields.name: MaxParallelStreams
fields.description: Changes built side by side; 0 = custom (agreed with sales).

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Queue weight: higher goes first.

fields.name: FeaturesJson
fields.description: JSON array of plain feature lines.

fields.name: ContactSales
fields.description: True: no list price, people contact sales.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: False: not offered any more (existing subscriptions keep it).

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order on the plan cards.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the server; unique index.

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: The organization (workspace) the subscription belongs to; unique.

fields.name: PlanKey
fields.description: Plan.Key of the plan.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: active|pending|cancelled.

fields.name: StartedAt
fields.description: ISO time the plan started.

fields.name: RenewsAt
fields.description: ISO time of the next renewal (empty for Free).

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the server; unique index.

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: The organization whose credit moves.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: The person the entry is for (the requester of a job, the redeemer, the asker).

fields.name: ProjectId
fields.description: Project of a usage entry.

fields.name: JobId
fields.description: EngineJob of a usage entry (one usage entry per job: RequestKey usage:<JobId>).

fields.name: Kind

fields.name: AmountUsd
fields.description: USD with two decimals: + grant, - usage.

fields.name: AmountCents

fields.name: Tokens

fields.name: Note
fields.description: Reason or description.

fields.name: At
fields.description: ISO time of the movement.

fields.name: CouponCode
fields.description: Coupon.Code of a coupon entry.

fields.name: PlanKey
fields.description: Plan.Key of a plan entry.

fields.name: DetailJson
fields.description: Usage detail JSON {tokens:{in,out,cacheRead,cacheWrite,total}, costUsd, models, priceFactor}.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the server; unique index.

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: Upper-case code people type; unique.

fields.name: AmountUsd
fields.description: Credit in USD the coupon grants.

fields.name: PlanKey
fields.description: Optional Plan.Key the coupon puts the organization on.

fields.name: MaxRedemptions
fields.description: How many organizations may redeem it; 0 = no limit.

fields.name: Redemptions
fields.description: How many have redeemed it.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description: ISO time after which it cannot be redeemed (empty: never).

fields.name: Active

fields.name: Note

fields.name: Status

fields.name: Note

fields.name: DecidedBy

fields.name: DecidedAt
fields.description: ISO time of the decision.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the server; unique index.

fields.name: UsageJson
fields.description: What the job's lanes measured, JSON {v:1, tokens:{in,out,cacheRead,cacheWrite,total}, costUsd, models:[...], agents, lanes} (src/domain/billing.ts parseJobUsage); written by the engine worker as each lane finishes.
